sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes Insanity from all allies.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Grace for 60 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
Only [Horns of Fertility] Dionysus can be used as Unlocking Potential material
